$comment: Appliance:CONTROL. Source: docs/appliances/README.Appliances.md. The catalog marks BUTTON optional; this slice is the electric-lock profile (lock:827: 1 MAINTAINED input, 1 LEVEL button, 1 output), which composes it, so it is listed as required here. Per-lamp sub-components (lamp.1..M) and GROUPS are not part of the M2 slice.
startup: Configure lever.inputs, button.inputs and lever.outputs from NV config, extinguish every lamp, read the switch contacts and report switches.
